acceptance: A `v0.1.0` tag publishes all 8 wheels and the sdist; `pip install benchbox-datagen==0.1.0` imports and generates TPC-H SF 0.01 on Linux, macOS and Windows.
The publish job runs only on tags and uses no stored token.
Wheels contain THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES with the TPC legal notice (test on the built wheel).
description:
## Problem
BenchBox can pin the library only from PyPI. No publish job exists and no Trusted Publisher is configured.

## Change
Owner: add a PyPI pending Trusted Publisher (repo BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen, workflow wheels.yml, environment pypi). Agent: add a tag-triggered publish job to wheels.yml (OIDC, no stored token) that uploads the 8 wheels and the sdist; tag v0.1.0 once TPC-H and TPC-DS are merged.

## Decision gates
- Owner-only: the PyPI publisher setup. Tagging 0.x releases is pre-approved (owner 2026-11-26 decision 1).
- A wheel built with a git `[patch]` dependency is publishable; an sdist that cannot build offline from crates.io is acceptable only if the README says so; otherwise stop and ask.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree; heavy work only through make heavy-run; never kill processes by name pattern.
- No divergent fork of tpcgen-rs; carried patches only under the 2026-11-27 rule (<= ~200 changed lines, upstream PR, SHA pin, README entry); anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first.
- Human commit identity, no agent attribution. Report only observed results.
